name: 07974 · New Providnce, NJ
findings: ZIP 07974 (New Providnce) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07974 (New Providnce) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
